verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only a bare 'scenario history' doc entry, a thin first-party sign that past scenario executions can be inspected; the error-handling pages mention error handlers but nothing about re-running failed executions. Nothing in the pack shows re-running a failed execution or resuming from the failing step. missing for 10: documented execution log detail, re-run of failed executions, resume-from-failing-step capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can inspect past execution logs and re-run a failed execution, resuming from the failing step
